contenders.handicapper_notes: Possesses the highest individual speed figure in the race with a standout 80 rating on debut when closing powerfully from tenth to finish second by a neck at Ballarat over 1000m. Resumes here for top trainer Lindsey Smith following an impressive trial victory at Geelong on September 16. Despite drawing wide out in gate 9 post-scratchings, his closing turn of foot (C) stamps him as the benchmark runner.

Well-bred Pinatubo gelding from the Ben, Will & JD Hayes stable dropping steeply from a 108k Saturday metropolitan 2yo event at Caulfield into country maiden grade. Has trialled brilliantly leading into this return, capturing a Flemington 800m jump-out on September 11 in sharp 46.4s. Inherits barrier 1 following scratches, providing him the prime tactical stalking run (P) along the favoured rails in Moe sprint dashes.

Score significantly boosted due to Post-Scratch Lone Speed (+6). With early scramblers scratched, this daughter of Hanseatic is the undisputed lone front-runner (E) in the field. Showed high cruising speed when leading throughout on debut at Pakenham before finishing fifth beaten only 1.6 lengths. Carries 55.5kg and has the natural gate dash from barrier 4 to control the tempo around the cambered Moe bend on Good 4 ground.

Brings race fitness edge as a third-up runner. Was beaten only 1.5 lengths when third two back over 1000m and ran solidly for sixth last start at Pakenham Synthetic. Moves to turf on Good 4 and maps smoothly from gate 2 to settle just behind the leading group (S).
